doc.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020

title: Closing thoughts and thanks
summary: Final remarks that the band members must be one voice and thanks between Rowe and Gabriel.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I’m going to memorize some of your words today. Fascinating. And I’m so glad you came to meet with us today.
Oh I’m glad you had me.

You are the music. You are the music. And you just have to realize that. They have to feel that they are the music. They have to really feel it to be speaking with one voice. And when it’s time for your solo you can do anything you want to do on your solo, I don’t care what you do. But when you come back, one voice. And that’s the way everybody can stay on track because there ain’t no written music here. We are the music.
All right. Thank you for your time today.
Oh man, thank you for having me. RB: Bravo.
